name: Antimanual – The Ultimate AI Solution for Your Site
author: Spider Themes

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site with Antimanual, the all-in-one AI powerhouse.

Antimanual isn’t just a plugin; it’s your intelligent assistant. It seamlessly combines a smart Chatbot, Auto-Posting, Documentation Generator, Bulk Rewrite tools, Forum Automation, and AI Search to revolutionize how you manage your site.

Whether you’re a business owner looking to reduce support costs, a content creator needing to scale production, or a developer wanting to streamline documentation, Antimanual is the solution.

Key Features

  • Intelligent AI Chatbot
    Train a custom chatbot on your own content—posts, pages, PDFs, and URLs. It delivers instant, accurate answers to your visitors, reducing support tickets and boosting engagement. Now with GPT-5 support!

  • Auto-Posting & Content Creation
    Put your content strategy on autopilot. Schedule and automatically publish fresh, SEO-optimized posts based on your chosen topics and tone. Keep your blog active without lifting a finger.

  • AI Documentation Generator
    Instantly generate comprehensive, clean documentation. Select your language, tone, and structure, and let the AI build professional docs for your products or services.

  • Bulk Rewrite & SEO Optimization
    Refresh your existing content in bulk. Rewrite posts to improve readability, update information, or target new keywords. Automatically generate SEO-friendly excerpts, tags, and terms.

  • Forum Automation
    Breathe new life into your forums. Automatically convert closed topics into helpful knowledge base posts and generate smart AI replies to keep discussions moving.

  • Smart Knowledge Base
    Build an organized knowledge system by converting your existing content into structured, searchable resources. Supports PDFs, URLs, and custom text.

  • AI-Powered Search
    Upgrade your site’s search experience. The customizable AI search block understands user intent and delivers relevant results, complete with editable text and icons.

Why Choose Antimanual?

  • Save Time: Automate repetitive tasks like content writing, support responses, and documentation.
  • Boost SEO: Keep your site fresh with auto-posting and optimized content rewrites.
  • Improve User Experience: Provide instant answers with the chatbot and smart search.
  • Easy to Use: A seamless, React-based admin dashboard makes configuration a breeze.

Useful Links

  • Get Antimanual Premium – Unlock the full potential.
  • Documentation – Learn how to use every feature.
  • Support Forum – Get help from our team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload: Upload the antimanual folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure: Go to Antimanual > Settings in your dashboard.
  4. Connect: Add your OpenAI API key to enable the AI features.
  5. Enjoy: Start leveraging AI-powered features!
sections.faq:
What is Antimanual?

Antimanual is a comprehensive AI plugin for WordPress that offers features like a custom chatbot, auto-posting, documentation generation, and more to automate and enhance your website.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes, Antimanual uses OpenAI’s powerful models (like GPT-4 and GPT-5) to function. You will need to provide your own API key in the settings.

Can I train the chatbot on my own data?

Absolutely. You can train the chatbot using your website’s posts, pages, custom text, PDFs, and even external URLs.

Is the Auto-Posting feature fully automated?

Yes! Once you set your topics, tone, and schedule, Antimanual will generate and publish posts automatically according to your plan.

Does it work with Forumax?

Yes, we have deep integration with Forumax. You can automate replies to forum topics and convert solved topics into permanent documentation or blog posts.

Is there a premium version?

Yes, while the free version is powerful, Antimanual Premium offers advanced features and higher limits. Check the “Useful Links” section for more info.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0 (07 January 2026)

  • New: Allowed site admins to set a custom response for irrelevant queries in chatbot settings
  • New: Enhanced admin tables with advanced controls across multiple pages
    • Implemented search, sort, and pagination functionality
    • Synced table state (search, sort, pagination) with page routes to persist data across page refreshes
  • Updated: Removed Screen Options from Antimanual admin pages
  • Updated: Plugin requirement for forum automation is changed from bbPress to Forumax
  • Improved: Disabled the chat reset button when the user has not sent any message yet
  • Improved: Show suggested questions when the user has not sent any message yet
  • Improved: Adjusted chat reset button position for empty headers in EazyDocs integration
  • Improved: Moved the Auto Posting tab after the Bulk Rewrite tab
  • Fixed: Monthly conversation usage for the chatbot feature not displaying correctly
  • Fixed: Apply button in Screen Options not working
  • Fixed: Unable to change the response model in the configuration
  • Fixed: Knowledge Base posts not updating correctly and duplicate post issues

2.0.0 (16 December 2025)

  • New: Auto-Posting feature – automatically generate and publish WordPress posts based on scheduled topics
  • New: Antimanual Search block – intelligent search functionality with query feedback for the block editor
  • New: Seamless admin dashboard experience – rebuilt as a React-based SPA for instant loading
  • New: Knowledge Base expansion – supports PDF uploads, Website URLs, Custom Text, and existing Posts
  • New: Cross Domain Embed – easily embed the AI chatbot on external websites
  • New: Chatbot logic upgrades – GPT-5 support, self-reference capability, and access to conversation history
  • New: Documentation Generator – generate detailed documentation using AI
  • New: bbPress Integration – AI-generated answers for forum topics and topic-to-post conversion
  • New: Conversations listed in dashboard – track user interactions with the chatbot
  • Updated:Visual overhaul for Admin navigation tabs and Chatbot frontend design
  • Updated: Knowledge Base management – now includes table layout, bulk actions, and filters
  • Updated: Standalone architecture – removed EazyDocs dependency
  • Updated: Enhanced UI for all generator tabs (Terms, Excerpts, bbPress)
  • Updated: Chatbot experience – dark mode support, local storage history, and improved mobile UX
  • Updated: Performance – switched to SVG icons and optimized asset loading

1.0.0 (05 December 2025)

  • Initial release
